text:
Alex Kim: planning to roll a config-only change to routing weights + batching limits in the evening canary window (21:00 PT). No model version change.
Deploy Bot: /deploy start id=rb-deploy-5943210000 canary=10% config-only
Maria Chen: noted, I'll enable the per-route latency dashboard and SLO monitors :eyes: 
Jenna Ortiz: what's the exact throttle? we saw kv cache pressure last month.
Alex Kim: throttle=0.85, max_batch_tokens=1024, batch_timeout_ms=40, route_priority=latency. Starting canary at 21:00, 10% traffic for 15m.
Ryan Patel: recommend emergency rollback criteria: >1% 5xx OR p95 > 500ms sustained for 10m.
Jenna Ortiz: adding config toggle now. snippet:
```json
{"route_policy":"latency_first","throttle":0.85,"max_batch_tokens":1024,"batch_timeout_ms":40}
```
Ops Runner: I'll create alerts: token-latency > 200ms for 5m and 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m; will notify #eng-oncall and escalate to oncall if triggered.
Maria Chen: also kick off smoke evals for the top-50 prompts pre/post canary and watch embedding regressions.
Deploy Bot: rollout started — canary at 10% (rb-deploy-5943210000). Metrics stream is live.
Alex Kim: plan to ramp to 50% at 21:20, then 100% at 21:40 if no alerts. Manual hold at each step, do not auto-ramp past holds.
Jenna Ortiz: confirmed pinned model remains v2.4.0 — no model artifacts changed here.
Ryan Patel: watching kvcache pressure and async queue depth, will call rollback on spikes.
Alex Kim: thanks all — after final ramp, please add a short release note: "config-only: routing priority + batching limits tweak (throttle 0.85, batch_timeout_ms 40)" :white_check_mark:
